subject: Request: remediation validation package and compensating control details
messages:
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@finrise.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finrise.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Follow-up: pen test findings — request for remediation evidence

Hi Sean / Lauren,

Thanks again for walking through the summary call last week. Our security team completed a review of the Red Team report and identified three medium findings that require validation before we can close the review on our side:

- Issue A: improper KV cache lifetime on model-serving nodes (repro steps in report page 7)
- Issue B: unauthenticated metrics endpoint accessible from internal VPC
- Issue C: stale SSH keys on legacy bastion (rotated but no proof provided)

Can you please provide a consolidated validation package that includes for each finding:
1) a short remediation summary (what changed)
2) concrete evidence (screenshots of config or commands, config snippets, or paste of CLI commands used)
3) ticket references (JIRA or internal ticket id) and dates
4) if the fix is compensating rather than direct, an explanation of compensating controls and why they are sufficient

Ideally we'd get this by EOD Friday (2026-12-04) so we can finalize our SOC scope next week. If any of these require more time, please outline a schedule and any mitigations in place.

We expect redacted artifacts only (no secrets) and a single consolidated package or drive link.

Thanks,
Alex
Security Engineering — Finrise

[Attachment: finrise_report_excerpt.pdf (pdf, excerpt of findings referenced)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@finrise.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test findings — request for remediation evidence

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a remediation validation package and aim to get an initial bundle to you by Thursday EOD, latest Friday morning. Quick notes on ownership:

- Rishi is taking lead on Issue A (KV cache lifetime / model-serving nodes).
- I'll own Issue B (metrics endpoint) along with Monica for the change coordination and release notes.
- Lauren will coordinate the SSH key rotation evidence for Issue C.

We'll include screenshots, sanitized config snippets, and JIRA refs. If any team needs more time for screenshots (hard to capture in prod window), we'll provide terminal output and a short video clip link.

Action: Rishi, please collect artifacts for Issue A and attach the JIRA ticket(s). Monica / Lauren — please confirm your ETA.

Thanks,
Sean
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

[Note: internal reference — ticketing will be under RBW-SecRemediation project]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Soto <alex.soto@finrise.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test findings — request for remediation evidence

Alex / team — attaching the artifacts for Issue A. Summary below.

Summary: the KV cache lifetime default was reduced and an explicit eviction policy applied to the model-serving process (affects nodes in pool-gamma). We also added a token-bound TTL enforcement to prevent stale state reuse.

Evidence attached:
- redwood_pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf — short remediation write-up (redacted)
- screenshot_kv_cache_cfg.png — UI screenshot of the new cache TTL set to 00:10:00 for pool-gamma
- JIRA-4521_fix_patch.diff — branch patch showing the TTL change and test harness update
- audit_log_sample_20261130.txt — sanitized log extract showing TTL enforcement on a sample request

JIRA: https://finrise.atlassian.net/browse/FR-938 (internal mapping: RBW-SecRemediation-4521).

Compensating controls: we added a runtime assertion and a periodic cache revalidation cron that removes entries older than 15 minutes (mitigates accidental misconfiguration), and we require API-level token rotation for long-running sessions.

Notes on evidence: screenshots are redacted for PII and we removed node IPs. If you need more verbose config files, we can provide a sanitized /etc/redwood/cache.conf snippet.

-- Rishi
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf; screenshot_kv_cache_cfg.png; JIRA-4521_fix_patch.diff; audit_log_sample_20261130.txt]

From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@finrise.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, security@finrise.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:06:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test findings — request for remediation evidence

Rishi / Sean — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. A few follow-ups from our side after reviewing the attachments:

1) The screenshot shows TTL change but we need a short snippet of the actual running config (redacted values ok) for the cache conf (e.g., the exact key names and the TTL line).
2) For the audit_log_sample_20261130.txt — can you confirm the timezone and the host identifier mapping (we need to map the log lines to the nodes listed in the report)? A simple table or mapping is sufficient; no IPs required.
3) For the compensating controls (cron and token rotation), please provide:
   - the cron schedule line and the container image tag used for the job
   - the token rotation policy (TTL and rotation cadence) and whether it is enforced via KMS or an internal service

Also, please add the remediation dates on each JIRA ticket and mark them with the remediation label so our tracker can auto-close the findings.

If you can get these items by Friday midday we can proceed to sign off. If anything blocks, let us know what the blocker is and an expected ETA.

Regards,
Alex
Security Engineering — Finrise

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@finrise.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 17:58:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test findings — request for remediation evidence

Alex — final bundle below and brief responses inline. We created a sandboxed folder with redacted files and the mapping table.

- Cache conf snippet (sanitized): /drive -> cache.conf.snip (contents: cache.pool = pool-gamma
  cache.ttl = 600  # seconds)
- Audit log mapping: audit_mapping.csv (host alias -> node role) — timezone: UTC.
- Cron: crontab line: 0,30 * * * * /usr/bin/remediate-cache --env=prod (container image tag: redwood/remediate:2026-11-29-rc3)
- Token rotation: token TTL = 12h; automatic rotation enforced via Redwood KMS-backed token-rotation service (internal).
- JIRA tickets: RBW-SecRemediation-4521 (remediated 2026-11-28), RBW-SecRemediation-4522 (metrics endpoint, remediated 2026-11-27), RBW-SecRemediation-4523 (SSH key rotation, remediated 2026-11-26).

We attached the sanitized snippets and the mapping CSV to the Drive link below. We also included a short manual runbook entry describing the compensating cron and the KMS binding for the token-rotation service.

Drive link (redacted access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-remediation

If you need us to sign an evidence attestation or provide the full unredacted artifacts under an NDA channel, we can route that through our legal team — just confirm the contact and the scope.

Thanks,
Sean
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

[Attachments in Drive: cache.conf.snip; audit_mapping.csv; remediation_runbook.md]
